Help & Information

How to use FinTrack and answers to common questions.

How to Use FinTrack

FinTrack brings your bank and cash balances, expenses, liabilities, gold and SIP investments, household and friends splits and settlements into one secure dashboard. The areas appear in this order:

  1. Overview — total bank & cash balance with the currency toggle, quick links, monthly flow, insights preview and recent activity.
  2. Accounts — add bank accounts, cash in hand and credit cards; balances update everywhere.
  3. Transactions — every money movement for the month, including transfers and settlements.
  4. Monthly Expenses & Income — record an expense against a category, add income, and see the month table with settlement logs.
  5. Household — members, shared household expenses with splits and household settlements. The three-dot menu holds add expense, record settlement, add member, PDF, exit and delete.
  6. Gold Purchases & SIP Investments — gold purchases with conversion analysis and SIP holdings.
  7. Loans & Liabilities — track loans with payment logs and close them when settled.
  8. Trip Split — group trips, who paid and who owes.
  9. Bank Transfers — move money between your accounts, with live conversion when the currencies differ.
  10. Friends Split & Settlements — split an expense with friends and settle the balance.
  11. Financial Insights — savings and category overview for the chosen period, with one month calendar and a "This month" shortcut.
  12. Profile & Notifications — your information, friends and alerts.
  13. Settings — visibility, currencies, theme, exchange rates and people.
  14. Help & Ratings — this page and your feedback.
Expense Categories — add your own

Every category list now ends with + Add category... — in Monthly Expenses, in Household expenses and in Friends Split. Choose it, type the name and it is saved immediately.

A category you add is shared across the whole app: it appears in every category list and in Financial Insights as soon as you record an expense with it.

Rename or Delete your own categories from the same window. Renaming moves your existing expenses to the new name, and deleting keeps the old expenses under their saved name. The built-in categories (Food, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Medical, Other) cannot be edited or deleted.

First Login Guide

When you log in for the first time, FinTrack welcomes you by name with a short motivational quote, then walks you through a six-step guide so you can start using the app confidently.

The six steps: Welcome → Select Your Currencies → Add a Bank Account or Cash → Add Your Accounts → Start Using FinTrack → Visibility Settings.

Visibility Settings let you choose which information appears in your Financial Overview — Total Bank & Cash Balance, Total Liabilities, Total Savings & Gold, Net Financial Balance, Individual Bank & Cash Balance Summary and other overview items. If any information is not required, you can turn it off and save your preferences.

These settings are optional and can be changed any time from Settings. The welcome and guide appear only once; you can revisit this guide here anytime.

Financial Overview

Shows your total bank and cash balance, liabilities, savings and gold, and net financial balance. Use Visibility Settings to hide liabilities or savings for a simpler view.

Theme System

FinTrack supports multiple visual themes to personalize your dashboard. All themes are free for everyone:

  • Default Light — the standard look.
  • Rose, Emerald, Ocean — color-tinted light themes.

Go to Settings → Theme Picker to choose a theme. Your theme choice is saved to your profile and applied every time you log in.

Currency Priority & Sorting

FinTrack displays currencies in a fixed regional priority order:

  1. INR — Indian Rupee (always primary by default)
  2. Gulf currencies — SAR, AED, OMR, QAR, BHD, KWD
  3. Global currencies — USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, UZS

When you select multiple currencies in Settings, they are automatically sorted by this priority. Your Primary Currency is the first in the list, and your Secondary Currency is the first non-INR currency. All financial summaries, dropdowns, and account tables follow this order.

Monthly Expenses

Log shared monthly expenses with categories. Each entry can be deducted from a chosen account.

Income

Use the Add Money feature to record income or deposits into any saved account.

Bank and Cash

All bank accounts are added under one Bank Accounts box. Each account belongs to the account group and currency configured in Settings, and the list shows the group name you entered. Spending is shown separately for each configured currency. Cash in Hand has its own box and a simple entry with currency and balance only. Detailed guidance lives here in Help, so screens show titles and icons only.

Bank and Cash Transfers

Record transfers between your accounts. Balances update automatically.

Credit Cards

Track credit card outstanding amounts and due dates. Reminders appear near the due date.

Loans and Liabilities

Track loans with payment logs and closing status.

Gold and SIP

Record gold purchases and SIP investments with conversion analysis.

Savings Goals

Use SIP investments to track progress towards your savings goals.

Friends

Add friends from the dashboard. Tapping a friend card opens their profile with balance details and actions: Send Reminder, Notification Settlement, Settlement, Split Transaction and Remove Friend. Pending Payments (who owes whom) also live in the Friends area. Settlement opens with the current pending balance pre-filled and can be edited for partial payments.

Friends Split

Split expenses with friends. Registered friends sync between both accounts; non-registered friends are tracked manually.

Settlements

Record friend and shared settlements in one area. The history shows the settlement type for each record.

Profile

View your personal information, friends and notifications.

Notifications

Notifications from friends, such as payment reminders, can be viewed from a friend's three-dot menu in Profile. You can delete any notification manually. Notifications that you do not delete will automatically disappear after one week from the time they were created.

Settings

Configure visibility, currencies, exchange rates and people.

Is My Data Safe?

Your data is stored securely in Firebase and is only accessible with your account.

Who Can View My Data?

Only you can view your financial data. Shared records are visible only to the connected users involved.

Is My Password Stored in FinTrack?

No. Passwords are managed securely by Firebase Authentication and are never stored in the FinTrack database.

Can Another User Access My Account?

No. Each account is private. Only shared splits and settlements you create with another user are visible to that user.

What Happens to My Financial Data When the App Is Updated?

Updates never delete your data. Hiding a section only hides the display; your records remain intact.

Can I Use More Than One Currency?

Yes. Use Keep Selected Currency Only to limit the app to one or two currencies. INR remains the default base currency.

Why Do I See Categories When Adding an Expense?

Categories help you analyse spending patterns across Food, Transport, Shopping, Bills and Other.

What Is the Purpose of the Expense Graph?

The expense graph helps you understand spending patterns by category over time.
